# dokploy_git_providers (Data Source)

Fetches all git providers from Dokploy (GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, GitHub).

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_git_providers" "all" {}

# Output all git provider IDs by type
output "gitlab_providers" {
  value = [for p in data.dokploy_git_providers.all.git_providers : p if p.provider_type == "gitlab"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `git_providers` (Attributes List) List of all git providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git_providers))

<a id="nestedatt--git_providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git_providers`

Read-Only:

- `bitbucket_id` (String) The Bitbucket-specific ID (if provider_type is bitbucket).
- `gitea_id` (String) The Gitea-specific ID (if provider_type is gitea).
- `github_id` (String) The GitHub-specific ID (if provider_type is github).
- `gitlab_id` (String) The GitLab-specific ID (if provider_type is gitlab).
- `id` (String) The git provider ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the git provider.
- `provider_type` (String) The type of git provider (gitlab, bitbucket, gitea, github).
